data.narrative:
Stratek Global is a growth-stage nuclear energy company founded by Kelvin Kemm. The valuation universe comprises 9 peers across public and private markets: 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 6 private firms, including Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy. This peer set reflects the broader nuclear energy sector.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. Despite identifying 5 same-sector peers, the filtering criteria for stage alignment, stage adjacency, and valuation-tier comparability yielded fewer than 3 datapoints in any single category. Relying on an unfiltered, all-sector median would introduce material bias and obscure meaningful stage and scale differences within the nuclear energy landscape. Consequently, no triangulated valuation range can be supported by the data provided.

A credible valuation of Stratek Global would require either: expanded access to pricing data from private comparable transactions at similar growth stages; disclosure of specific financial metrics (revenue, EBITDA, capex profiles) that would allow for revenue or cash-flow multiples; or additional peer transactions that narrow the comparison set. Without these inputs, quantitative analysis is not defensible. Further diligence should prioritize securing contemporaneous pricing data from recent raises or secondary transactions among the identified peer cohort.
